_about: VRF-8 (owner rulings 2026-11-10 13:56-15:05, from the VRF-7 review): the hvac_vrf keys and question changes HVAC v64 adds over v63. Read by vrf8Model.test.ts and by scripts/_instruments/mint_hvac_v64_vrf8.py (test_vrf_v64 proves the asset equals it). Every key is optional: v63 without them is unchanged.

feeder_length.line: Power cable: the BoQ says "{said}" ({where}) - {n} m used as the power cable length (owner D4)

breaker_words.question: includes_mccb
breaker_words.line_both: MCB + ELCB: the BoQ says "{said}" ({where}) and also "{ec}" ({ec_where}) - added as the safe choice (owner D5)
breaker_words.line_ec_only: MCB + ELCB: NOT added - the BoQ says "{ec}" ({ec_where}): the electrical contractor's scope (owner D5)

connection_only.line: {label}: NOT added - the BoQ says "{said}" ({where}) - connection work only (owner D8)

mode_nearest.line: The nearer heading says "{near}" ({near_where}) and another says "{far}" ({far_where}) - the nearer heading wins: priced as {value} (owner D9)

install_follows.line: Installation only: the supply of this {family} {capacity} is quoted on row {row} as {make} - priced as {make} (owner D10)

repeated_size.line: The row states {kept} twice and {other} once - priced at {kept} (owner D11)

several_types.refusal: several unit types under this heading - fix the headings or pick the type (owner D12)

tfa_outdoor.line: BoQ says "{said}" - the fresh-air unit is priced with an outdoor unit of the stated {hp} HP (owner D14-1)

first_make_close.line_next: several makes stated ({said}): {first}'s smallest is {min} {unit}, too big for the BoQ's {want} {unit} - priced as {make}, the next stated make with a close size (owner D14-2)
first_make_close.line_default: several makes stated ({said}): {first}'s smallest is {min} {unit}, too big for the BoQ's {want} {unit}, and no other stated make has a close size - priced as {make} (owner D14-2)

implied_includes_add.question: includes_frame
implied_includes_add.line: MS frame / stand: the BoQ says "{said}" ({where}) - "supports" in the outdoor unit's rate / heading = the MS stand (owner D2)

stated_not_stocked.line: The BoQ states {written} {unit}; {missing} {unit} is not stocked for {make} - the stated setup could not be followed, priced by the split rule on the total {total} {unit} (owner W2 / W3)

note_wins_add.line_silent: {label}: not added - the BoQ note says "{said}" ({where}) (owner W5)

supply_heading.note: BoQ: the heading says "{heading}" and its note says "{said}" ({where}) - priced as supply + installation (owner D1)

note_words.line: MCB + ELCB: the BoQ says "{said}" - the unit's own starter panel has switches with fuses; MCB + ELCB still added, please check (owner D1)

conflict_add.both_line: Remote: the BoQ says "{first}" and also "{said}"{where} - priced as {value}, please check (owner W7)

lines_add.drain_cable_line_silent: Power cable: not added - the BoQ's cabling "{said}" ({where}) is for the drain pump, not the unit's power cable (owner D6)
lines_add.drain_cable_row_line: Power cable: NOT added - the BoQ's cabling "{said}" is the drain pump's: the sheet quotes it only on the drain-pump row ({rows}) (owner D7)

question_notes_append.*required: VRF-8: REQUIRED on every item - never leave it out. Answer Yes or No from the words wherever anything describes this unit's price or scope for it (decide - never leave it out because it is hard to tell); 'None' only when nothing at all describes it. With Yes, the _words answer copies ONE exact clause of the BoQ (never '...') and _where says where it sits.
question_notes_append.*words: VRF-8: ONE exact clause copied as written (never shortened with '...'); a note shows it only when it is found word for word.
question_notes_append.includes_frame: VRF-8: 'supports' in an OUTDOOR unit's rate or heading ('inclusive of ... vibration isolators, supports') is its MS frame / stand: Yes.
question_notes_append.includes_power: VRF-8: 'inclusive of plug top & necessary power cable' on a unit is its power cable: Yes; cabling 'for the drain pump' is not. 'Necessary interconnections with power supply / earthing / refrigerant connections' is connection work only: No.
question_notes_append.includes_copper: VRF-8: 'necessary interconnections with power supply / refrigerant connections' is connection work only, not the copper piping: No.
question_notes_append.includes_mccb: VRF-8: 'breaker (if required)' in a note = Yes, even where another note puts the MCCB / isolator in the electrical contractor's scope; the electrical contractor's scope alone = No.
question_notes_append.extra_power_length_as_written: VRF-8: 'single feeder / DB ... within N m(tr) distance from ODU' is the outdoor unit's power cable length: N m.
question_notes_append.capacity: VRF-8: a fresh-air (TFA) unit 'complete with suitable outdoor unit' is TWO items - the fresh-air unit and an Outdoor Unit with the HP the row states. One capacity written twice and another once: copy the repeated one.
question_notes_append.cooling: VRF-8: when the headings above a unit disagree on cooling / heating, the heading NEARER the row wins.
